Osmotic uses Bluetooth to find your DJI camera and ask it to turn on its Wi-Fi.
Osmotic talks to your camera on its own Wi-Fi network (192.168.2.1) to list and download your files.
Osmotic saves your camera’s videos and photos to the DJI folder in Downloads.
Osmotic shows your DJI camera’s picture when it’s plugged in by USB as a webcam.
macOS only shows your Wi-Fi network’s name to apps with Location permission. Osmotic uses it to get you back on your network when it’s done. It never records your location.
